## Core Pilgrimage Services & Pricing Governance

1. **Saudi Arabia Umrah E-Visa (`PKR` Fixed Tiers)**:
   - **Short-Term Umrah Visa (`<= 30` days KSA stay)** and **Long-Term Umrah Visa (`31–90` days KSA stay)** are computed automatically from KSA Arrival Date and KSA Departure Date.
   - Includes mandatory Saudi healthcare and emergency medical insurance plus step-by-step Saudi Visa Bio smartphone fingerprint guidance.
   - Standalone **Visa-Only** applications display an immediate fixed PKR total upfront.
2. **Custom 5-Pillar Umrah Journey Builder (Live Verified Rates)**:
   - Configures Visa + Flights + Makkah/Madinah Hotels (`0m` Haram Courtyard to `24/7` Shuttle) + KSA Ground Transport / Haramain High-Speed Train + Scholar-Guided Ziyarat.
   - Whenever volatile services (Flights, Hotels, Transport, Ziyarat) are selected, pricing is confirmed via itemized proposal (`"Live Rate — Confirmed upon submission"`) from the Lahore quoting desk.
3. **Haramain Routing & Traveller Capacity Rules**:
   - **Makkah Entry Lock**: Makkah has no civilian airport; Makkah-first itineraries arrive at King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah (`JED`) with immediate ground or Haramain High-Speed Train transfer (`~75` minutes by road). Madinah-first itineraries can land directly at Madinah Airport (`MED`).
   - **Family Bed & Seat Accounting**: Hotel beds and vehicle seat capacities count `Adults (12+ yrs) + Children (2–11 yrs)`. `Infants (< 2 yrs)` require a passport, Saudi visa, and infant air ticket, while taking `0` hotel beds and `0` vehicle seats.
4. **Hajj 2027 Pre-Registration (`Maktab A+`, `A`, `B`, `C`)**:
   - Indicative 16-to-38-day non-shifting Haramain courtyard and Aziziyah shifting structures. Final Maktab tariffs and quotas remain subject to official Saudi Ministry of Hajj & Umrah and Pakistan MORA announcements.

## Primary Public Hubs & Guides

- [Homepage & Custom 5-Pillar Umrah Journey Builder](https://alramlahtravels.com/): Build custom Umrah itineraries, compare group departures, and track live application status.
- [Umrah Packages 2026–2027 from Pakistan](https://alramlahtravels.com/umrah-packages): Fixed-departure Economy, Silver, Gold, and Royal VIP 5-Star Umrah group packages in PKR.
- [Umrah Packages from Lahore (LHE)](https://alramlahtravels.com/umrah-packages/from-lahore): Direct Allama Iqbal International Airport departures serving Lahore, Gujranwala, Faisalabad, and Sialkot.
- [Umrah Packages from Karachi (KHI)](https://alramlahtravels.com/umrah-packages/from-karachi): Non-stop Jinnah International Airport departures serving Karachi, Hyderabad, Sindh, and Balochistan.
- [Umrah Packages from Islamabad (ISB)](https://alramlahtravels.com/umrah-packages/from-islamabad): Islamabad International Airport departures serving the Twin Cities, Potohar, KP, and AJK.
- [Saudi Umrah E-Visa Rules & PKR Rates](https://alramlahtravels.com/umrah-visa): Short-term (`<=30d`) vs long-term (`31–90d`) e-visa fees, documents checklist, Saudi Visa Bio biometrics, and NICOP/diaspora guidance.
- [Hajj 2027 Packages & Maktab Guide](https://alramlahtravels.com/hajj-2027): Maktab `A+`, `A`, `B`, and `C` comparison, shifting vs non-shifting stays, and indicative pre-registration.
- [Makkah Haramain Hotels Guide](https://alramlahtravels.com/hotels/makkah): Clock Tower courtyard (`0m`), Ibrahim Al Khalil Road, Ajyad walking, and Kudai 24/7 shuttle properties.
- [Madinah Masjid an-Nabawi Hotels Guide](https://alramlahtravels.com/hotels/madinah): Markaziyah Northern Courtyard, Ladies Gate 25 frontage, and Southern Courtyard hotels.
- [Sacred Ziyarat Landmarks Overview](https://alramlahtravels.com/ziyarat): Scholar-led historical circuits and private SUV/van/minibus fleet options.
- [Makkah Ziyarat Sites Guide](https://alramlahtravels.com/ziyarat/makkah): Jabal al-Nour (Cave of Hira), Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat, Jannat al-Mu'alla, and Masjid al-Jinn.
- [Madinah Ziyarat Sites Guide](https://alramlahtravels.com/ziyarat/madinah): Masjid Quba, Mount Uhud, Masjid al-Qiblatayn, Seven Mosques (Khandaq), Jannat al-Baqi, and Bir Uthman.
